note: CB.23 (tier-5 mount-segment fold): a client path behind an opaque base (`${ADMIN}/users/${id}/status` -> `/{}/users/{}/status`) pairs with the one route whose path ENDS with the folded path behind one or more LITERAL mount segments (`POST /admin/users/:id/status`, `GET /back/office/audit/log`), reported as base_fold. Before CB.23 the Go routes were minted unprefixed and the fold paired them at their local path; once the mounts are resolved, the fold that only stripped API prefixes reached none of them (Kina: 29 admin pairings). Unique target only: a tail served behind two mounts (`/admin/reports`, `/ops/reports`) pairs with neither. A folded path that is itself a route keeps the old tier (`GET /health`, never `/admin/health`).

expect_edges.note: control: the folded path is a route, the existing base-fold tier wins
